 Live .  37,160 viewing 37160 viewing Live page Updated 1 minute ago Antonelli leads US Grand Prix as he targets F1 title
 United States Grand Prix
 BBC Radio 5 Live
 Close United States Grand Prix
 BBC Radio 5 Live
 Listen live Live Reporting (active) 
 Leaderboard 
 Summary
 Kimi Antonelli leads US Grand Prix 
 Antonelli will win title with race victory and George Russell finishing ninth or lower and Lewis Hamilton fifth or lower
 Russell given five-second penalty
 Hadjar second, Verstappen third and Russell fourth
 Verstappen, Leclerc and Hamilton have pitted for fresh tyres
 Select 'listen live' for BBC Radio 5 Live commentary (UK only)
 Close form Send us your F1 views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Lorraine McKenna
 Verstappen up to P3 published at 20:36 GMT 20:36 GMT 
 Lap 19/56 
 George Russell has been dispatched with ease by Max Verstappen, and now the Dutchman is 16 seconds behind race leader Kimi Antonelli. 
 Pierre Gasly doesn't put up a fight when Lando Norris comes knocking on the door for his P8 spot. The Frenchman drops to ninth, but he hasn't pitted yet. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 63 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:35 GMT 20:35 GMT 
 Damon Hill 
1996 world champion on BBC Radio 5 Live in Austin 
 Max Verstappen has lost a little bit of pace on these soft tyres now.
 149 76 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Verstappen closing in Russell published at 20:34 GMT 20:34 GMT 
 Lap 18/56 
 Max Verstappen is rapid on his fresh soft rubber and now he's chasing down George Russell. The Mercedes driver is yet to pit and serve his five-second time penalty, and the Red Bull is inching closer and closer. 
 105 64 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:34 GMT 20:34 GMT 
 Andrew Benson 
BBC F1 correspondent in Austin 
 At the moment, Antonelli looks in complete control of this race. All the frontrunners could be on two stops and Antonelli on a one stop. That would be a statement of intent.
 114 23 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 McLaren opt for hard tyres published at 20:33 GMT 20:33 GMT 
 Lap 17/56 
 Lando Norris and team-mate Oscar Piastri have been placed on the hard compound by McLaren, and the world champion comes out in ninth place, ahead of the Australian, who needs to get past Esteban Ocon. 
 72 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:32 GMT 20:32 GMT 
 Andrew Benson 
BBC F1 correspondent in Austin 
 Problem is, Max Verstappen has to do a two stop now which is not what we were expecting at all. It was thought to be a one stop race. That's really put the cat amongst the pigeons. Does this mean everyone else has to do a two stop now?
 103 24 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:31 GMT 20:31 GMT 
 Lap 16/56 
 With these flurry of pit stops. Kimi Antonelli has stayed out. The championship leader has an 11-second lead over Red Bull's Isack Hadjar, as Max Verstappen continues his charge back up the order. 
 World champion Lando Norris - get yourself into the pits. 
 88 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Hamilton makes pit stop published at 20:30 GMT 20:30 GMT 
 Lap 15/56 
 Image source, Getty Images Can Lewis Hamilton get in and out ahead of Liam Lawson? Not quite. The seven-time world champion is behind the Racing Bulls driver but he's soon able to clear him on his fresh medium tyres. 
 Oscar Piastri is next to come, just as Max Verstappen gets through on the McLaren and is up to fifth. 
 142 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:29 GMT 20:29 GMT 
 Damon Hill 
1996 world champion on BBC Radio 5 Live in Austin 
 I think I saw bits of debris come off Max Verstappen's tyres, maybe there is something wrong with Max's car, he's struggling a little bit. 
 204 83 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:28 GMT 20:28 GMT 
 Lap 14/56 
 Max Verstappen heads in to the pits early and takes on more soft tyres for this next stint. The Dutchman comes out and is also already up on Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson and is now P8. 
 Ferrari react also and tell Lewis Hamilton to come in for a compound change. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 111 19 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:28 GMT 20:28 GMT 
 Damon Hill 
1996 world champion on BBC Radio 5 Live in Austin 
 I've been watching the gap between Kimi Antonelli and Max Verstappen. Antonelli is comfortable where he is and doing slightly faster lap times than Verstappen. I think we're in tyre management mode now
 118 19 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Verstappen heading into the pits published at 20:27 GMT 20:27 GMT 
 Lap 13/56 
 Gabriel Bortoleto has avoided picking up a time penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage, so the Audi driver can carry on in P16. 
 Red Bull are ready to call in Max Verstappen fro. second place. 
 92 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:25 GMT 20:25 GMT 
 Lap 12/56 
 Fernando Alonso might be limping slightly but that doesn't mean he can't make waves up at Turn One. he gets Alex Albon early in the lap to reclaim P15 from the Williams man. Albon's team-mate Carlos Sainz is down in 18th place, Lance Stroll has made his way to P20 after his pit-lane start. 
 82 17 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:25 GMT 20:25 GMT 
 Damon Hill 
1996 world champion on BBC Radio 5 Live in Austin 
 George Russell can't seem to stay away from trouble at the moment!
 104 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:24 GMT 20:24 GMT 
 Lap 11/56 
 Kimi Antonelli is fairly comfortable out in front with a 2.7-second gap over the Red Bull of Max Verstappen. His team-mate George Russell now has a five-second time penalty to serve from sixth place, but Lewis Hamilton is still in the mix in fourth spot. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 156 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:22 GMT 20:22 GMT 
 Lap 10/56 
 Alex Albon and Fernando Alonso have already had a few scuffles in this race, and now the pair are battling it out for 15th place. The pair are switching positions but Albon makes the move stick at Turn One to stay ahead of the two-time world champion. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 69 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Team radio - Lando Norris to McLaren published at 20:22 GMT 20:22 GMT 
 Team engineer: "How much pace do you have in hand?"
 Norris: "I mean... Uh yep I'm being held up now."
 79 52 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:21 GMT 20:21 GMT 
 Damon Hill 
1996 world champion on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra in Austin 
 Charles Leclerc's overtake on Max Verstappen through turns six, seven and eight has got be one of the bravest moves we've seen all seeson, it was incredibly committed and caught Max out really well. Great racing in those first few laps but it's more strung out now, we're waiting to see the pace as the tyres start to degrade.
 151 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Five-second time penalty for Russell published at 20:20 GMT 20:20 GMT 
 Lap 9/56 
 George Russell is in sixth spot at the moment, which is enough for the title to carry on to Mexico next week. But now the Mercedes driver has been hit with a five-second time penalty. He'll be staying put for a few seconds when he comes in to pit. 
 112 132 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 20:20 GMT 20:20 GMT 
 Select the 'Get Involved' button to have your say 
 Kimi doesn't need to win, he just has to keep bringing it home in the good points. Max is going for it - Kimi doesn't need any drama.
 Barry, Plymouth
